title: 第13章男人大丈夫能屈能伸，打不过就加入-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “学长……”

    正当小舞要提醒马红俊时，唐三及时将她拦了下来。

    他不喜欢多管闲事，更想趁机看看马红俊的实力。

    万一坏了叶寒的好事，将他得罪了，吃亏的只会是他们。

    遇到这种情况，最好的方法就是选择沉默。

    小舞看到唐三的摇头行为，瞬间明白了他的意思，到嘴边的话，被她咽了回去。

    “学妹，你放心，我会手下留情，不会伤害他的。”

    马红俊还以为小舞是担心他下手太狠了，拍着胸脯向她做出保证。

    能得到学妹的青睐，让他的心情大好。

    宁荣荣望着他那自信满满的样子，嘴角微微一抽。

    这个死胖子，可真够自信的，真以为自己的实力很强啊。

    “废话真多。”

    叶寒有点听不下去了，瞬间闪身来到他的面前，一拳打在他的肚子上。

    剧烈的疼痛，让马红俊喘不过气来，缓缓蹲了下来。

    “艹，小子，你玩儿阴的，学长我还没有准备好呢。”

    痛觉渐渐好转，马红俊站起身来，拉开距离，生怕叶寒继续偷袭。

    幸好他肚子上的肉很厚，否则那一拳足以让他失去战斗力。

    “敌人会给你准备的机会吗？”

    “看来你们史莱克学院的教学方式也就那样。”

    叶寒被马红俊的话逗乐了。

    双方对战，还需要提前准备。

    这不是在拿生命开玩笑吗？

    如果马红俊面临的是敌人，他现在已经变成一具尸体了。

    “艹，你小子，真够狂，竟然还敢骂我们史莱克学院。”

    “今天不好好地教训你一下，还翻天了不成。”

    马红俊听着叶寒这番话，气炸了，唤出武魂邪火凤凰。

    当着学妹们的面前这么骂他，简直就是在践踏他的尊严。

    为了维护尊严，在漂亮的学妹们面前扬威，他必须拿出全部实力，让这小子吃点苦头。

    “咦，是顶级兽武魂火凤凰。”

    “这家史莱克学院果然各个都是天才。”

    朱竹清看到马红俊的武魂，眼前一亮。

    在斗罗大陆，兽武魂绝对是最主要的武魂。

    而在众多兽武魂中，龙类武魂、白虎类武魂和凤凰类武魂都是十分强大的顶级兽武魂。

    其中，蓝电霸王龙武魂是最强的，被誉为斗罗大陆最强兽武魂，而白虎类武魂则是以星罗皇室的传承武魂邪眸白虎为尊。

    至于凤凰类武魂，就比较少见了。

    但每一种凤凰类武魂，都拥有强大的战力。

    难怪马红俊这么自信，凤凰类武魂就是他最大的依靠。

    “第二魂技·浴火凤凰。”

    马红俊深吸了口气，第二枚魂环点亮。

    此时，他的背后衍生出两只火焰翅膀。

    在第二魂技的加持下，他的周身燃起暗红色邪火铠甲，火焰紧贴皮肤。

    身上冒出来的凤凰火焰威力直接增强百分之三十，身体韧性也大幅度提升，增强了抗揍能力。

    “凤凰火线。”

    马红俊将战力推到极致，当即使用第一魂技。

    只见他张开嘴，口中喷出一道赤红色带黑边的高温火柱，喷射而去。

    沿途中，气温骤升十几度。

    “不自量力！”

    叶寒丝毫不将马红俊的邪火凤凰武魂放在眼里，调动全身魂力和杀气，再次激活体内的祖龙血脉。

    吭！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Senior..."

Just when Xiao Wu was about to remind Ma Hongjun, Tang San stopped her in time.

He didn’t like to meddle in other people’s business, and wanted to take the opportunity to see Ma Hongjun’s strength.

If Ye Han's good deeds are ruined and he is offended, they will only suffer.

When faced with this situation, the best way is to choose silence.

Xiao Wu saw Tang San shaking his head and instantly understood what he meant. She swallowed the words that came to her lips.

"Sister, don't worry, I will be merciful and won't hurt him."

Ma Hongjun thought Xiao Wu was worried that he would be too harsh, so he patted his chest to assure her.

Being able to win the favor of his schoolmates made him feel good.

Ning Rongrong looked at his confident look and twitched the corner of her mouth slightly.

This fat guy is so confident, he really thinks he is very strong.

“There’s so much nonsense.”

Ye Han couldn't stand hearing it any longer, and instantly stepped in front of him and punched him in the stomach.

The severe pain made Ma Hongjun breathless and he slowly squatted down.

"Fuck, kid, you're playing dirty, senior, I'm not ready yet."

As the pain gradually improved, Ma Hongjun stood up and distanced himself, fearing that Ye Han would continue to attack.

Fortunately, the flesh on his belly is very thick, otherwise that punch would be enough to make him lose his fighting ability.

"Will the enemy give you a chance to prepare?"

"It seems that your Shrek Academy's teaching method is just like that."

Ye Han was amused by Ma Hongjun's words.

Both sides need to prepare in advance for a battle.

Isn’t this kidding with life?

“If Ma Hongjun was facing an enemy, he would have turned into a corpse by now.

"Fuck, you kid, you are so crazy, you dare to scold us at Shrek Academy."

"If I don't teach you a lesson today, it will turn the world upside down."

Hearing what Ye Han said, Ma Hongjun was furious and summoned the Martial Soul Evil Fire Phoenix.

"To scold him like this in front of the school girls is simply trampling on his dignity.

In order to maintain his dignity and show off his power in front of the beautiful school girls, he must use all his strength to make this kid suffer.

"Hey, it's the top beast martial spirit Fire Phoenix."

“As expected, everyone in this Shrek Academy is a genius.”

Zhu Zhuqing's eyes lit up when he saw Ma Hongjun's martial spirit.

In Douluo Continent, the beast spirit is definitely the most important spirit.

Among the many beast martial spirits, dragon-type martial spirits, white tiger-type martial spirits and phoenix-type martial spirits are all very powerful top-level beast martial spirits.

Among them, the Blue Electric Tyrannosaurus Dragon Spirit is the strongest and is known as the strongest beast spirit in Douluo Continent, while the white tiger martial spirit is based on the evil-eyed white tiger, the inherited martial spirit of the Xingluo royal family.

As for Phoenix martial spirits, they are relatively rare.

But every Phoenix-type martial spirit possesses powerful combat power.

No wonder Ma Hongjun is so confident, the Phoenix martial spirit is his biggest support.

"The second soul skill·Phoenix bathed in fire."

Ma Hongjun took a deep breath and lit up his second soul ring.

At this time, two flame wings sprouted from his back.

With the blessing of the second soul skill, his whole body ignited with dark red evil fire armor, and the flames clung to his skin.

The power of the phoenix flames emerging from the body is directly increased by 30%, and the physical toughness is also greatly improved, enhancing the ability to withstand beatings.

"Phoenix FireWire."

Ma Hongjun pushed his combat power to the extreme and immediately used his first soul skill.

I saw him open his mouth, and a red pillar of high-temperature fire with black edges spurted out from his mouth.

Along the way, the temperature suddenly rose by more than ten degrees.

“Don’t overestimate your own capabilities!”

Ye Han didn't take Ma Hongjun's evil fire phoenix martial spirit seriously at all, and mobilized his whole body's soul power and murderous aura to activate the ancestral dragon bloodline in his body again.
